verdicts.reason: A keeps the product-in-circle graphic intact, but squeezes everything into the top 40% and leaves the bottom 60% as dead orange. The 'Try It' pill runs off the right edge and is jammed under the NEW badge, out of line with the copy. B spreads the content out, but it breaks the key graphic: the cream circle is cut away into a clipped blob in the bottom-left corner. That leaves the can as an orange-on-orange outline that almost disappears. The headline is also too small, and the NEW badge and CTA float on different axes from the text block.
